eyeball.menu.title: Googly Goobers
eyeball.menu.subtitle: Googly eyes & goofy cartoon faces
eyeball.menu.preview.hint: Drag to rotate - scroll to zoom
eyeball.menu.server.active: Server sync: active - modded players see your look
eyeball.menu.server.inactive: Server sync: off - effects only show on your screen
eyeball.menu.server.no_world: Server sync: join a world to see sync status
eyeball.menu.voice.missing: Voice Lip Sync needs Simple Voice Chat
eyeball.option.googly_eyes.tooltip: Huge 3D googly eyes with eyebrows and a talking mouth. OFF removes them from everyone on your screen.
eyeball.option.talking.tooltip: When players chat (or speak, with Simple Voice Chat) their eyes swell up, the mouth flaps wide open and the brows bounce. The face matches the message: laughing, surprised, angry, shouting, and SCREAMING for "AAAAH" or yelling into the microphone.
eyeball.option.eyebrow_animations.toolti: Eyebrows bounce while talking and move with every expression and hit.
eyeball.option.eye_movement.tooltip: Wobbly googly pupils that follow where players look, glance at you, and bounce around.
eyeball.option.voice.tooltip: With Simple Voice Chat installed, mouths follow the real voice volume of whoever is talking.
eyeball.option.hit_reactions.tooltip: Getting hurt (players, mobs, falling, fire...) plays a cartoon reaction: shocked mouth, dizzy face.
eyeball.option.spiral_eyes.tooltip: Eyes turn into huge spinning hypnotic spirals when hit.
eyeball.option.head_wobble.tooltip: The head wobbles and the body staggers when hit.
eyeball.option.cartoon_stars.tooltip: Little stars orbit the head while dizzy.
eyeball.option.character_size.tooltip: Scales the whole cartoon face: eyes, eyebrows and mouth together.
eyeball.option.animation_speed.tooltip: How fast every animation plays: talking, blinking, pupils, screaming.
eyeball.option.expression_intensity.tool: How strongly each expression shows its own shape: angry brows, smiles, squints, the round surprised mouth.
eyeball.option.eye_enlargement.tooltip: How much the eyes grow when talking and screaming. 1.00x: about 1.6x bigger while talking and 2x while screaming. 0: the eyes don't grow.
eyeball.option.mouth_opening.tooltip: How wide the mouth opens when talking and screaming.
eyeball.option.exaggeration.tooltip: Turns all the cartoon motion up or down at once: eye growth and pops, mouth opening, eyebrow bounce, head nodding, swaying and shaking.
eyeball.option.apply_to_myself.tooltip: Show googly eyes on your own character (third person, inventory, mirrors).
eyeball.option.apply_to_everyone.tooltip: Show googly eyes on every other player on your screen. Use Player Selection to change individual players.
eyeball.option.show_synced.tooltip: Show googly eyes on players who chose them (or had them applied by the server). Needs Googly Goobers on the server.
eyeball.option.share_look.tooltip: Let other Googly Goobers players see your googly eyes. Needs Googly Goobers on the server. Players without the mod see a normal skin.
eyeball.players.title: Player Selection
eyeball.players.no_world: Join a world or server to choose players.
eyeball.players.reset_row: Use the global setting again for this player
eyeball.players.hint: Choices here override Apply to Myself / Apply to Everyone, only on your screen.
